comment: Recovery targets. RTO values are SPECIFIED design targets (operator steps + documented manifest propagation), not measured end-to-end; lab crypto time is measured in the drill. See docs/runbook.md and outputs/derived/quorum-model.json.

rotation_policy.rotation_mode: one validator at a time, quorum check between steps
rotation_policy.signing_key_rotation: every 6 months (docs recommend 6-12 months; best practice quarterly or semi-annually)

rpo.ephemeral_loss_or_compromise: 0 — no ledger data is lost; the validator re-syncs from peers
rpo.master_key_loss: N/A — the validator identity itself is lost
rpo.node_loss_with_shamir_backup: 0 — the master secret is rebuilt exactly (fingerprint verified in drill D)

rto_minutes.ephemeral_basis: 30 min operator steps (token, config, restart) + 5 min manifest propagation
rto_minutes.master_key_compromise_basis: revocation propagates in minutes; validator stays offline until re-onboarded as a new identity
rto_minutes.master_key_loss_basis: no RTO: identity unrecoverable; new identity needs VL republication + trust re-establishment (days, SPECIFIED)
rto_minutes.node_loss_basis: same as ephemeral, plus share gathering from 3 custodians
